description: Header file defining functions and variables for managing temporary directories and sandboxes in testing environment, including path validation, creation, cleanup, and platform-specific path canonicalization.

methods.name: is_valid_tmp_path
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a valid writable directory and within maximum path length.

methods.name: find_tmp_path
methods.description: Attempts to find a suitable temporary directory path from environment variables or defaults.

methods.name: canonicalize_tmp_path
methods.description: Converts a path to its canonical form, platform-specific.

methods.name: clar_tempdir_shutdown
methods.description: Removes the temporary directory and reverts to parent directory.

methods.name: build_tempdir_path
methods.description: Constructs and creates a temporary directory path.

methods.name: clar_tempdir_init
methods.description: Initializes the temporary directory environment and changes into it.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a string to a destination buffer, replacing ':' with '_' in the source.

methods.name: clar_sandbox_create
methods.description: Creates a sandbox directory for a specific test, named based on suite and test names or random hex.

methods.name: clar_sandbox_cleanup
methods.description: Removes the sandbox directory and resets its path.

methods.name: clar_tempdir_path
methods.description: Returns the path of the temporary directory.

methods.name: clar_sandbox_path
methods.description: Returns the path of the sandbox directory.
